literal: For the simple woman who has eye-filling beauty and bamboo-resembling shoulders, her womanhood-filled modesty is great.
translation: For this simple maiden of eye-filling beauty and bamboo-like shoulders, her abundant feminine modesty is indeed great.
modern: கண்களை நிறைக்கும் அழகுடைய, மூங்கில் போன்ற தோள்களைக் கொண்ட இந்தப் பெண்ணிடம், பெண்மை நிறைந்த குணங்கள் மிக அதிகமாக உள்ளன.
explanation: The hero admires the heroine's self-control and modesty. While she possesses eye-filling beauty ('கண்ணிறைந்த காரிகை') and beautiful shoulders resembling smooth bamboo ('காம்பேர்தோள்'), her feminine modesty and reserve ('பெண் நிறைந்த நீர்மை') are even more prominent. She does not easily betray her inner feelings, showing a dignified restraint that makes her even more attractive.
